messages:
maria: Heads-up — getting a noisy spike on model-serving.p99 latency across r2 pool during the internal load test. This is flooding the weekly oncall card. Can we do a short snooze (30m) while the test runs and then re-evaluate thresholds?

alerts-bot: Alert triggered: model-serving.p99 > 900ms (count=18) — view: https://dash.redwood.company/d/model-serving/latency

dan: Where's the trace link for the worst requests? want to see if it's one hotspot or many.

maria: Traces: https://traces.redwood.company/trace?query=model-serving%20p99&range=15m — filtered by router=route-r2. Logs: https://logs.redwood.company/app/model-serving?q=error%20or%20latency

tyler: If it's load-test traffic, short snooze sounds fine. Suggest patching alert to 1200ms for the duration to reduce noise, then revert.

jen: +1 for a 30m snooze, please include runbook link and add a note to the incident card.

sam: Can you paste the alert-manager snooze command? I can apply it quickly.

maria: Applying 30m snooze now. Running the API call —

# snooze alert by id
curl -X POST https://alert-manager.redwood.company/api/snooze \
  -d '{"alert": "model-serving.p99", "duration": "30m", "reason": "internal load test - noisy p99"}'

alerts-bot: Snooze created: https://alert-manager.redwood.company/snoozes/ae34f — expires in 30m :white_check_mark:

tyler: Also opened a quick PR to relax to 1200ms during the test window if we want an infra-side fallback: https://git.redwood.company/infra/alerts/pull/432 — please review.

maria: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.company/model-serving/p99 — steps to rollback routing and check KV cache warmup. I'll monitor dashboards and remove snooze earlier if things stabilize.

dan: Great. After snooze ends, let's check p50/p90/p99 and request a follow-up if p99 stays > 900ms for >2 hours.

maria: Will do. Note on the card: "snoozed for internal load test; TL;DR: noisy synthetic traffic causing p99 spikes; 30m snooze applied; follow-up if persistent."

maria: Update 30m later (post-snooze): Snooze expired, p99 dropped back to ~850ms but there are intermittent spikes around 1s. Opening task to investigate batching behavior and KV cache warmup: https://tickets.redwood.company/INFRA-781. Leaving alert unchanged for now, will propose a rate-based alert next week.

jen: Thanks for handling. If the ticket needs oncall triage, ping here. :thumbsup:
